widgets_values: The image portrays a serene, rustic courtyard featuring a traditional house with white walls and a sloped roof covered in weathered gray tiles. A skylight is incorporated into the roof design. The warm glow of interior lighting spills through a large window and an open door, revealing a cozy, well-furnished room with framed artwork and wooden furniture, including a dining table and chairs. Outside, the patio is planted with various lush flowers and green foliage arranged in white and terracotta pots. At the center of the patio sits a wooden rocking chair adorned with a patterned cushion or blanket, inviting relaxation. Nearby, red and pink blooms add vibrancy to the scene. The sky above transitions from sunset to evening, tinged with soft hues of blue and gray. A lantern near the door enhances the tranquil, welcoming ambiance, while palm-like leaves frame the view.This serene garden scene showcases a vibrant and meticulously maintained landscape. Winding stone stepping paths cut through lush, emerald-green grass, framed by an explosion of colorful flowers including blue hydrangeas, cheerful yellow daisies, and delicate white blooms. On the left, a stately house with wooden-framed windows is adorned with climbing ivy, blending seamlessly into the natural beauty surrounding it. Mature trees offer shade, while smaller bushes in terracotta pots add texture and depth. A cozy wooden bench is tucked amidst the greenery under a bright white canopy in the background, creating an inviting space for relaxation. Further back, walls draped in cascading greenery and blooming pink flowers enhance the tranquil atmosphere. The play of light filtering through the trees adds warmth to this idyllic setting, making it appear as though it belongs in a picturesque storybook.

This 100-square-meter traditional courtyard house has a U-shaped layout to create an enclosed courtyard space. On the left, the kitchen and dining room are lined with timber frames and translucent floor-to-ceiling windows, while copper cookware hangs from stone countertops and long wooden dining tables with pottery cutlery, while paper sliding doors divide the functional areas. The central main hall is decorated with double-layered wooden window lattices, the outer carved wooden windows are ajar, the inner layer of frosted glass reveals warm lighting, and the interior is furnished with linen-colored clay-colored L-shaped sofas, low coffee tables and tea sets, and the walls are cleverly integrated with 65-inch TVs in the background of ink paintings. The right side is enclosed by a cedar fence with jasmine vines climbing between the grids. The stepped vegetable garden in the northwest corner of the courtyard adopts a geometric shape, with a drip irrigation system visible between the gravel paths, and a pergola hung with seasonal melons and fruits; In the southwest corner, a 6x4-metre wooden platform is surrounded by modular outdoor furniture with indigo-printed waterproof cushions. In the center stands the 15-meter-high Chinese acacia tree, surrounded by a round stone bench. The whole courtyard is based on warm gray lime walls, bluestone slabs and patina decorations, and emerald plants and orange flowers and fruits are dotted in between. At noon, the shadows of the trees sprinkle on the dewy leaves, and the wood grain texture is particularly vivid in the light and shadow, outlining a warm courtyard picture of tradition and modernity.
